description: This file contains FastAPI endpoints and auxiliary functions for managing models within a proxy server, including creating, updating, deleting models, handling team-model relationships, and configuring public visibility of models. It integrates with database operations via Prisma and manages various administrative actions related to model management in a machine learning deployment setup.

classes.name: UpdatePublicModelGroupsRequest
classes.description: Request schema for updating public model groups, containing a list of model group names to be made public.

classes.name: ModelManagementAuthChecks
classes.description: A static class providing authorization checks for model management endpoints, including permissions for team and model actions.

methods.name: Optional[Deployment] get_db_model( model_id: str, prisma_client: PrismaClient )
methods.description: Fetches a Deployment object from the database by model ID.

methods.name: PrismaCompatibleUpdateDBModel update_db_model( db_model: Deployment, updated_patch: updateDeployment )
methods.description: Merges updates into a Deployment object to create a Prisma-compatible update dictionary.

methods.name: patch_model( model_id: str, patch_data: updateDeployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: PATCH endpoint to update model metadata in the database and cache, with authorization checks.

methods.name: Optional[LiteLLM_ProxyModelTable] _add_model_to_db( model_params: Deployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, prisma_client: PrismaClient, new_encryption_key: Optional[str] = None, should_create_model_in_db: bool = True, )
methods.description: Stores a new model record in the database, encrypting sensitive fields.

methods.name: Optional[LiteLLM_ProxyModelTable] _add_team_model_to_db( model_params: Deployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, prisma_client: PrismaClient, )
methods.description: Creates a team-specific model with a unique name, updates team alias mappings, and adds the model to the team.

methods.name: PrismaCompatibleUpdateDBModel _update_team_model_in_db( db_model: Deployment, patch_data: updateDeployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, prisma_client: PrismaClient, )
methods.description: Handles updating team model info, creating new alias if needed, or updating existing alias relations.

methods.name: str _get_public_model_name( patch_data: updateDeployment, db_model: Deployment, )
methods.description: Determines the appropriate public model name from patch data or existing model info.

methods.name: None _setup_new_team_model_assignment( team_id: str, public_model_name: str, patch_data: updateDeployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Sets up a new team model with a unique name and updates team alias mappings.

methods.name: None _update_existing_team_model_assignment( team_id: str, public_model_name: str, db_model: Deployment, patch_data: updateDeployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Updates alias mappings when a team model's public name has changed.

methods.name: delete_model( model_info: ModelInfoDelete, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Deletes a model entry, handling removal from database and optionally from in-memory router cache, with authorization.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,str]] delete_team_model_alias( public_model_name: str, prisma_client: PrismaClient, )
methods.description: Removes model alias entries associated with a specific public model name in team mappings.

methods.name: add_new_model( model_params: Deployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Adds a new model, storing it in database, optionally creating team alias, and updating router cache; logs actions.

methods.name: update_model( model_params: updateDeployment, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Old endpoint providing model parameter updates via PUT semantics; internally calls database update logic.

methods.name: update_public_model_groups( request: UpdatePublicModelGroupsRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Updates the list of publicly accessible model groups in the global configuration.

methods.name: update_useful_links( request: UpdateUsefulLinksRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Updates links related to useful resources within the configuration.

methods.name: List[Dict] _deduplicate_litellm_router_models(models: List[Dict])
methods.description: Removes duplicate models from a list based on model_info.id.

methods.name: clear_cache()
methods.description: Clears cached models from the router, preserving config models, then reloads only DB models.
